reuse.why: Extends the existing shared MONTH_WIDE_CATEGORY_CONDITIONS used by both month-wide queries and parses notes with the existing extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule is defined once (getFixedGroupIds plus one clause in the shared condition); nothing is copied.

placement.why: The rule lives with the existing month-wide category conditions in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the shared condition, its two queries' parameters and new tests change.

maintainability.why: Centralised, but the shared SQL fragment now carries a positional placeholder each query must remember to bind first, an implicit coupling documented only in a comment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both getBudgetData and getMonthWideCategories keep using MONTH_WIDE_CATEGORY_CONDITIONS.

one_place.where: MONTH_WIDE_CATEGORY_CONDITIONS with getFixedGroupIds in server/budget/actions.ts, used by every month-wide action through getBudgetData and getMonthWideCategories.
